name: manual_a704e0
claim: For a launchd job that invokes a repository Python CLI, use the repository virtualenv interpreter explicitly instead of bare python3: launchd does not inherit the interactive shell environment, so dependencies present in the developer shell can be absent from the service process.

decisions.notes: The local PT coordination monitor initially used bare python3 and could not import aiosqlite under launchd, while the same command worked interactively. Switching the job to .venv/bin/python restored the intended heartbeat pulse without changing repository code.
